summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes a 727 KB obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package declares a preinstall hook that runs setup.mjs, which downloads the Bun runtime from oven-sh/bun GitHub releases and then invokes the downloaded Bun binary against a sibling file math_init.js shipped at the tarball root. math_init.js is a 727 KB single-line, hex-mangled, string-array-obfuscated Bun-compiled bundle whose contents bear no visible relationship to the package's advertised purpose (a wrapper around npm install for private packages). The payload file is not covered by package.json `files` (which declares only bin, dist, src), so it is shipped outside the author-declared manifest yet is the file executed at install time. Running an opaque obfuscated payload under a freshly downloaded alternate runtime on every `npm install` gives whatever code is inside math_init.js full control of the installer's machine and bypasses Node-based auditing.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
